node.name: ground_station_request_router
node.description: Decide what the ground station operator wants to do about passes or link issues.

examples.msg: Sorry if this is a silly question, but I think we need to move Thursday's contact with the weather bird. I don't want to drop it, just push it to a later window if that's okay?
examples.why: keep the pass, move it to another window

ctx: Ground station desk, what do you need?
examples.msg: We lost the downlink on antenna 3 since one hour, no signal is coming at all from the spacecraft.
examples.why: downlink lost, reporting a link failure

ctx: hey, quick one about tomorrow's passes
Sure, which pass is it about?
examples.msg: cancel the 14:20 one for the cubesat completely, we don't need that pass anymore and nothing should replace it
examples.why: cancel a pass entirely; no reschedule

ctx: Hi, I'm covering for my colleague at the station today.
Welcome, what can I help you with?
examples.msg: The big dish outside makes a grinding noise whenever it turns and it moves kind of jerky. Someone should probably look at it.
examples.why: mechanical problem with dish needs servicing

examples.msg: hey, can we grab a slot on the north antenna for the new imaging sat next tuesday morning?
examples.why: new slot for a satellite not yet booked

ctx: Good afternoon, I am writing regarding the passes booked for Mission Kestrel.
Good afternoon. How can I help with those passes?
examples.msg: The spacecraft has entered safe mode, so we will not require Friday's 09:40 contact. Please remove it from the schedule entirely.

node.name: food_bank_router
node.description: Decide what the person contacting the food bank wants to do.

conditions.a: Is the user asking to arrange collecting a food parcel for themselves?
conditions.b: Does the user want to donate food or supplies to the food bank?
conditions.c: Does the user want to sign up for a new volunteer shift?
conditions.d: Does the user want to cancel or move a volunteer shift they already have?

ctx: Hi, sorry, I'm not sure who to ask about this.
No problem! I can help you collect a food parcel, drop off a donation, or volunteer with us. Which is it?
examples.msg: The first one, I think... sorry, it's been a really hard month.
examples.why: 'first one' refers to collecting a parcel

examples.msg: I'm not looking to pick anything up. I've got about twenty tins and a few bags of rice I'd like to bring over to you.
examples.why: bringing tins and rice to give

ctx: Good morning, I have recently retired and have some free time.
Good morning, how can we help?
examples.msg: I would like to put my name down to help sort deliveries on Saturday mornings, if there is space.
examples.why: new volunteer signup, not changing an existing shift

examples.msg: I signed up for some kind of helping slot thing on Wednesday but I can't make it now. Can I swap it to another day, or is that even possible?

ctx: Happy to help! We have open slots on Tuesday evening packing boxes and Thursday morning at the warehouse. Would you like one of those?
examples.msg: tuesday one

node.name: print_shop_handoff
node.description: Decide whether the print shop customer continues with the bot or goes to staff.

conditions.a: Bot OK: cust proceeds w/ current order/quote steps
conditions.b: Esc to CSR: cust asks for a live staff member

examples.msg: can I just talk to someone at the shop real quick?
hey, I'd rather go over my wedding invites with one of your staff, can somebody give me a call?

ctx: I can prepare your quote for 500 A5 flyers now, or connect you with a staff member. Shall I continue with the quote?
examples.msg: Yes, continue please, is fine for me.
examples.why: agrees to continue quote with bot

ctx: I can price that. What finished size do you need?
examples.msg: Before that, put me through to someone in prepress. I need to talk bleed and imposition on my PDF with a human.

ctx: Hello there, I'm putting together a memorial booklet for my grandmother.
I'm sorry for your loss. I can help you order booklets. How many copies would you like?
examples.msg: Thank you, that is very kind. It's rather an emotional one for me, and honestly I think I'd feel better talking it all through with one of your people in the shop, if somebody might ring me this afternoon. My aunt did the photos and they're quite old, you see.
examples.why: wants a shop person to ring her

ctx: Good evening, I'd like some posters for our church fete.
Lovely! How many posters would you like, and what size?
examples.msg: Oh dear, I've just realised the time and I must collect my son from football. Before I go, could you tell me whether your shop is open on Sunday afternoons, as I might pop in with the artwork on a memory stick instead? I'd be ever so grateful, it's been one of those days.
examples.why: asks opening hours; neither staff nor continuing

node.name: gallery_answer_followup
node.description: Classify how the collector reacts to the gallery assistant's last answer.

conditions.a: Ack: ans OK, no more info needed
conditions.b: Ans partial: needs more info on same work
conditions.c: Ans disputed: user says price/info wrong
conditions.d: Switch: asks about a diff work in catalogue

ctx: Good afternoon, could you tell me the dimensions of the small harbour oil by Elsa Marrow?
Certainly, it is 40 by 55 cm unframed and 52 by 67 cm in its frame.
examples.msg: Oh, that's perfect, thank you ever so much. My husband and I were measuring the wall above the piano last night, and it will sit there beautifully. That's everything I wanted to know for now, you've been very helpful.

ctx: yo what's the price on that big blue abstract by the door
That piece, 'Tidewater II' by Rafe Kollin, is listed at 12,400.
examples.msg: damn that's way outta my league. kinda digging that little bronze bird thing in the window though
examples.why: interest shifts to a different piece

ctx: The watercolour 'Morning Quay' is priced at 3,200 including the frame.
examples.msg: But the card on the wall is saying 2,300, not this.
examples.why: says the quoted price is wrong

ctx: Is the charcoal portrait series still available?
Two of the five drawings are still available, numbers 2 and 4.
examples.msg: Fine, whatever. What I actually need is the invoice for the print I bought last month resent. I've asked twice already.
examples.why: invoice resend request; no reaction option fits

ctx: hey, how old is the ceramic vase in room 2?
It was made in 1968 by the potter Ines Varga.
examples.msg: oh nice, and where's it been since then?
examples.why: asks provenance of the same vase

ctx: is framing included with the linocut prints?
Yes, all linocuts come with a simple oak frame at no extra cost.
examples.msg: great, that answers it, cheers

node.name: logbook_entry_confirmation
node.description: Decide how the aircraft owner responds to the summarised logbook entry.

ctx: Here's the entry: 100-hour inspection on N4821K, tach time 2,315.4, oil changed, completed 12 March. Shall I save it, or is anything off?
examples.msg: the second number is wrong, should be 2,351.4

ctx: Log the new alternator on my Cherokee.
Summary: alternator replaced, part number AL-2290, installed 4 June on N77TR. Confirm?
examples.msg: No, for crying out loud, it's N77RT, not N77TR. Fix the tail number before you save that.

ctx: Enter the ELT battery swap, P/N 88-3104, done today, IA signoff by Hollis.
Entry: ELT battery replaced, P/N 88-3104, today's date, signed off by IA Hollis. Save to the airframe log?
examples.msg: Affirm, post it.

ctx: I've drafted the entry: annual inspection on your Skyhawk, N3390P, completed by R. Delgado on 2 October, no discrepancies. Do you want me to record it?
examples.msg: Yes, I think so, that all looks right to me... sorry, I'm new to owning a plane.

ctx: Please add the pitot-static check for my Bonanza.
Entry: pitot-static and transponder check, completed 18 May, N515BW. Shall I save it?
examples.msg: Hold on, first tell me when this check is due again so I can plan ahead. Also, the hangar door jammed on me again this morning.
examples.why: asks a question; neither confirm nor correct

node.name: drone_registry_handoff
node.description: Decide whether the drone registry assistant can handle the request or a case officer is needed.

conditions.a: The request is a routine self-service task the assistant completes itself: registering a new drone, renewing a registration, or updating owner contact details.
conditions.b: The user needs a human case officer, for example for enforcement notices, disputed fines, appeals against refused licences, or an explicit request to talk to staff.

examples.msg: so I got a letter saying I flew over a restricted park and owe 400 bucks, but I was nowhere near there that day

ctx: Hello, this is the drone registry assistant. What can I help you with?
examples.msg: I just got my first drone as a birthday present and I'm worried I'm not allowed to fly it until it's on your system somehow?

ctx: Good morning, I have a question about my licence application.
Good morning. I can help with renewals and registrations here, or put you through to a case officer if your application was refused and you wish to appeal. Which applies?
examples.msg: It is the latter, unfortunately.

ctx: Welcome to the drone registry. How can I help?
examples.msg: I want take a course for fly drone for my work, do you have list of training schools in my region?
examples.why: wants training schools; neither self-service nor case officer

examples.msg: these guys slapped an enforcement notice on me and took my freaking drone at the beach, what the hell am I supposed to do now
examples.why: enforcement notice needs a case officer

node.name: booking_info_answer_type
node.description: Classify what kind of information the user's reply supplies after the assistant asked for a detail.

conditions.a: The reply gives a date or time for the booking or activity, either exact (14 March, 7pm) or relative (next Friday evening).
conditions.b: The reply gives an existing booking reference or membership number, such as a code like CC-2041 or a member card number.
conditions.c: The reply picks one of the rooms or programmes the assistant listed, by its name, its position in the list or a description of it.
conditions.d: The reply says the user does not know or cannot remember the requested information, without refusing to give it.
conditions.e: The reply declines or refuses to provide the requested information, for example over privacy concerns or unwillingness to share it.

ctx: Hi, I need to change my hall booking, I hope that's okay.
Of course. Could you give me your booking reference?
examples.msg: Yes, sorry, I think it's CC-7318. It was on the confirmation email, I hope that's the right one.

ctx: wanna rent a room for my band to practise
Sure! We have the Oak Room (small, carpeted), the Main Hall (large, with stage), or the Basement Studio (soundproofed). Which would you like?
examples.msg: the soundproof one obviously, we're loud as hell
examples.why: picks the listed studio by description

ctx: To look up your yoga class enrolment, what's your membership number?
examples.msg: I don't remember it, the card is somewhere at home. Also, is the class still running next week?

ctx: need the hall for my kid's birthday bash
Great! When would you like to book it for?
examples.msg: she turns six the saturday after next so that afternoon is good, gonna be chaos

ctx: Good evening, I would like to book a meeting room for our residents' association.
Certainly. Which date would you like?
examples.msg: Before I choose a date, could you please tell me what the hourly rate is for the meeting rooms?
examples.why: asks price instead of answering; no type fits

ctx: Before we sign your son up for the youth football programme, could you give me your home address?
examples.msg: mate, I've had enough scammy crap this year to know better than typing where I live into some chat box

node.name: pass_request_answer_type
node.description: Classify what the visitor's reply supplies after the pass office asked for a detail.

ctx: Which pass do you need: 1) single-day visitor, 2) contractor 30-day, 3) contractor annual?
examples.msg: number 2

ctx: Good morning, I am a delivery driver who needs access on Thursday.
Thank you. Could you please provide your home phone number and date of birth?
examples.msg: I would rather not share those details through this channel.

ctx: When will you be visiting the base?
examples.msg: so it's for my cousin's graduation ceremony, that's the 4th of next month
examples.why: gives the day via the ceremony

ctx: I need a contractor pass for the hangar refit job.
Sure. What's the number on your passport or driving licence?
examples.msg: My driving licence number is HRT 448201 9KD.

ctx: I'm visiting someone on base next week.
examples.msg: Sergeant Talia Brenner invited me, she works in the motor pool.

ctx: I need a visitor pass for Friday.
Who is the sponsor for your visit?
examples.msg: I'm honestly not sure who's signing for me, my uncle just told me to come to the gate.
examples.why: doesn't know the answer; not a refusal

node.name: scout_registration_confirmation
node.description: Decide how the parent responds to the summarised scout activity registration.

conditions.a: The parent wants to confirm the summarised registration as correct and submit it.
conditions.b: The parent wants to change some detail of the summarised registration before submitting.

ctx: Here is the summary: Leo Park, Cub pack, summer camp 14-17 July, vegetarian meals, medical form attached. Shall I submit it?
examples.msg: Oh, thank you for putting that together so neatly. I'm terribly sorry, but we've just found out we'll be away visiting my mother-in-law that week, so I'm afraid we'll have to withdraw Leo from the camp altogether. He'll be ever so disappointed, he loves the campfire songs.
examples.why: withdraws from camp; neither confirm nor change

ctx: Summary: Maya Okoro, Scouts, badge evening on 3 May, permission slip signed by Ruth Okoro. Is this correct?
examples.msg: Every detail there matches what I filled in on the form.

ctx: Summary: Sam Ellery, Beavers, autumn hike on 9 October, pickup by Dan Ellery at 4pm. Shall I confirm this?
examples.msg: Ah, lovely, thank you. Sam has been talking about this hike for weeks, he's even been practising knots on the dog's lead. Yes, please go ahead and confirm it, everything there is right.

ctx: Summary: Noor Haddad, Cubs, weekend camp 21-23 June, emergency contact Sami Haddad. Confirm?
examples.msg: oh wait, make that her aunt Rima instead

ctx: I'd like to sign Theo up for the canoe day.
Summary: Theo Brandt, Scouts, canoe day 2 August, no allergies listed. Shall I submit it?
examples.msg: Hmm, Theo did come out in hives after that peanut incident last spring.

node.name: funeral_arrangements_router
node.description: Decide which part of the funeral arrangements the family is contacting the funeral home about.

conditions.a: The family wants the funeral home to collect the deceased, for example from a hospital, care home or private residence, as the first step after a death.
conditions.b: The caller wants to plan or change the service itself, such as date, venue, music, readings, or whether it is a burial or cremation.
conditions.c: The caller asks about costs, packages or payment options for the arrangements, including instalments, but not about obtaining official documents.
conditions.d: The caller needs help with paperwork such as death certificates, registering the death, or permits required for burial or cremation.
conditions.e: The caller wants to place or update a published obituary or death notice, including its wording, photo and where it appears.

examples.msg: hey, not asking about the certificates yet, just want a rough idea what a simple cremation package costs and if we can spread it over a few months
examples.why: price and instalments, explicitly not paperwork

examples.msg: Third time asking. The registrar says they still haven't got the medical paperwork from you, and we can't get the death certificate without it. Sort this out.
My father is die this morning in the Saint Anne care house, and the nurse ask me when somebody will come for him.
examples.why: deceased needs collecting from care home

ctx: Hello, I call about my mother, Mrs Ilse Varn.
I'm so sorry for your loss. Is this about the service itself, the paperwork, or the costs?
examples.msg: The first thing, please. We want change something.

Good morning, I hope you don't mind me getting in touch. You looked after my husband's funeral back in the spring and everything was handled beautifully. I've been struggling a bit lately, and my daughter suggested I ask whether you know of a bereavement support group that meets locally, perhaps in the evenings.
examples.why: asks for grief support group; not covered
